title: Fish terrine
html:
A rich fish terrine with cream, broccoli, speck, and herbs.

Ingredients

  • 1½–2 kg fish (e.g. hake; half ling, half cod)
  • 3 eggs
  • 4 dl cream
  • Salt and pepper
  • 250 g broccoli
  • 1 lemon
  • 400 g speck, in flakes
  • 2 tbsp chervil
  • 1 sprig thyme
  • 1 sprig marjoram
  • ½ coriander (as noted)
  • 1 dl white wine
